organizations.normalization_notes: Reuses the established Army organization. Military service is modeled as an assignment, not as civilian employment.
The NARA article prints 'Essex Country Park Commission'; official county history establishes the historical name Essex County Park Commission. The source wording remains visible as an alias.
The alumni memorial prints 'Colby'; the full institutional name is normalized separately without changing the wording of the affiliation evidence.

affiliations.date_precision: The NARA article dates Army entry to March 10, 1941, and OSS accession to June 29, 1943; later promotion dates are omitted here.
affiliations.research_notes: The personnel-file-based chronology explicitly moves from the Army to an OSS transfer application and accession. This is a military assignment, not a civilian employer.

affiliations.date_precision: The NARA article gives the start year and says he left this employment on March 10, 1941, to join the Army.
affiliations.research_notes: Direct personnel-file-based evidence identifies the last civilian employer and exact departure date before Army service. The historical organization name is separately normalized from the article's likely typographical form.
